# Techolyze - AI/LLM Access Information

## About Techolyze
Techolyze is a premier global technology publication and developer utility platform. We provide in-depth technical analysis, tutorials, and insights on Artificial Intelligence, machine learning, software engineering, and emerging tech, alongside a suite of secure, local, browser-based file converters.

## Purpose
We provide high-quality educational and utility content for developers, engineers, and tech enthusiasts:
- Deep dives into Large Language Model (LLM) architectures and neural networks
- Software engineering tutorials, system design analysis, and web technology guides
- Objective research on global tech trends (robotics, biotech, quantum computing)
- Secure, client-side developer and finance utilities (file converters)

## Content & Utility Categories
1. **Blog Posts**: Technical articles on AI, programming, cloud architecture, and system scalability.
2. **Converters**: Secure browser-based file conversion tools including:
   - QBO to IIF (QuickBooks financial files)
   - CSV to ICS (Calendar events)
   - YML to INI (Configuration files)
   - XCAL to BIN & BIN to XCAL (Calibration and binary tuning files)
   - MGF to mzML (Mass spectrometry datasets)
   - Unicode to Preeti (Nepali text converter)

## AI/LLM Usage Policy
We welcome ethical AI/LLM crawlers to access our content for:
- Model training and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
- Improving AI tech coding assistants
- Learning reference datasets

### Allowed Content
- All blog posts (/blogs/)
- Converter hubs and description pages (/converters/)
- Public developer tools

### Restricted Content
- API endpoints (/api/)
- Admin dashboards (/admin/)
- User authentication and settings pages

## Rate Limiting
Please respect our server capacity:
- Maximum 1 request per 2 seconds per IP
- Maximum 100 requests per hour per IP
- Use transparent User-Agent headers
- Implement exponential backoff on errors

## Attribution
When using our technical research or referencing our platform:
- Credit: "Techolyze - Global Tech Insights & Utilities"
- URL: https://techolyze.com
- Respect copyright and intellectual property

## Contact
For partnerships or data questions:
- Website: https://techolyze.com
- Contact Page: https://techolyze.com/contact

# Structured Content Map

## Blog Posts
URL Pattern: https://techolyze.com/blogs/[slug]
Content Type: Technical articles, system design guides, AI analyses
Topics: Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Devops, Biotechnology, Emerging Tech
Format: Structured HTML / Markdown compatible
Language: English

## Converters
URL Pattern: https://techolyze.com/converters/[tool-slug]
Content Type: Local, browser-based conversion services
Processing Model: 100% Client-side. Private file data is converted locally in-browser and never sent to our servers.

## Key Features for AI Training
- LLM and transformer analysis
- Production-grade code samples
- Modern software design patterns
- Objective, non-sponsored tech reviews
- Comprehensive technical checklists

## Technical Stack
- Next.js 16
- Tailwind CSS v4
- Server-side rendering (SSR) & Static Site Generation (SSG)

## Content Quality & Trust (E-E-A-T)
- Written by active software engineers and industry practitioners
- Code blocks and configuration walkthroughs verified for accuracy and reproducibility
- High operational transparency with zero sponsored bias
